author: John Steptoe, T. Marie Harris
description:
This is the tale of Mufaro's two daughters, two beautiful girls who react in different ways to the king's search for a wife - one is mean and selfish, the other kind and dignified. Cinderella with an African folktale twist.

This wonderfully illustrated classic comes from the award winning writer John Steptoe and is narrated by author T. Marie Harris.

author: Chieri Uegaki, T. Marie Harris
description:
Despite what's popular, or cool, Suki adamantly decides to wear her beautiful blue Kimono on the first day of 1st grade.  Not everyone is accepting or even nice about her choice, but Suki shows them all just how cool embracing your authentic self can be!

"Suki's Kimono" by award winning Japanese Canadian author Chieri Uegaki. Read aloud by author/storyteller T. Marie Harris
